blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Architectural drawings encode material classes through repeated hatch patterns. We test whether a connectome-constrained fly visual network, pretrained for motion, can be repurposed without task-specific weight updates as a descriptor for one-shot hatch matching. Each 64 × 64 64\times 64 patch is translated over eight scan trajectories and summarized across 57 cell types; query descriptors are then matched to one legend strip per class. On 400 development sheets from a synthetic benchmark built on CubiCasa5K geometry, the frozen fly pipeline reaches 0.857 area-weighted accuracy and 0.910 with an extended legend. On an equal-brightness orientation condition it reaches 0.840 versus 0.299 for eleven pixel statistics, while a Gabor bank reaches 0.900. Replacing drift with a repeated still frame lowers the combined equal-condition score by 0.089 [0.066, 0.112]. However, a receptors-only descriptor reaches 0.891 and a task-trained 5,888-parameter CNN averages 0.959, so the current evidence supports transfer and the usefulness of active sampling, but not an advantage of the biological wiring. We separate project-recorded results from recomputed checks and report a small real-drawing audit. The supported claim is therefore narrow: motion-oriented biological vision can be repurposed as a useful texture representation for architectural hatch matching, while the topology contribution and end-to-end BIM utility remain open questions.
blocks.zh: 建筑图画通过重复的舱门图案编码材料类. 我们测试一个连接的受约束的飞行视觉网络,预先训练用于运动,是否可以在没有任务特定重量更新的情况下被重新使用,作为一弹孔匹配的描述符. 每个64×64 64\times 64补丁通过8个扫描轨迹进行翻译,概括了57个细胞类型;然后将查询描述符匹配为每个类一个传说条. 在从CubiCasa5K几何学上建立起来的合成基准上的400个开发板上,冷冻的蝇子管达到了0.857区加权精度和0.910的扩展传说. 在平等定向条件下,11个像素统计值达到0.840比0.299,加博尔银行达到0.900。 用重复的静框取代漂移,使合并的等条件分数降低0.089 [0.066,0.112]. 然而,只有受体的描述符达到0.891,任务训练的5,888参数CNN平均为0.959,因此目前的证据支持转移和主动采样的有用性,但并不是生物线的优势. 我们把项目记录结果从重新计算的检查中分离出来,并报告一次小型的实时审计。 因此,支持的主张是狭义的:面向运动的生物视觉可以被重新定位为建筑舱门匹配的有用纹理表现,而地形的贡献和端到端的BIM效用则仍然存有疑问.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Architectural drawings use repeated hatches to encode materials and assemblies. A local wall region can have nearly the same outline and mean intensity as another region while differing in orientation, pitch, or stroke arrangement. This makes hatch interpretation a useful testbed for texture representations: geometry alone is insufficient, yet the task is much narrower than full floor-plan understanding.
blocks.zh: 建筑图纸使用重复的舱门来编码材料和组装. 局部的墙壁区域与另一个区域几乎具有相同的轮廓和平均强度,但在方向、投球或中风安排上则有所不同。 这使得舱门解释成为纹理表达的有用的试验床:光是几何技术是不够的,然而任务比全面的地平线理解要窄得多.

blocks.en: This paper asks whether a visual circuit developed for motion can be repurposed for this static document problem. The model is flyvis , a connectome-constrained network for the fly visual system whose parameters were previously optimized for motion-related predictions [ 1 , 2 ] . We do not model a living fly and do not claim whole-brain emulation. Instead, small drawing patches are translated across the model input, converting spatial texture into temporal activity. A fixed summary of that activity becomes a descriptor used for within-sheet legend matching.
blocks.zh: 本文询问为运动开发的视觉电路是否可以重新用于这个静态文档问题. 模型为flyvis ,是飞行视觉系统的一个连接电动机约束网络,其参数此前被优化用于运动相关预测[1,2]. 我们不模拟一只活的苍蝇,也不要求整个大脑的模仿。 相反,小的绘图补丁被翻译到整个模型输入,将空间纹理转化为时间活动. 该活动的固定摘要成为表内图例匹配所使用的描述符.

blocks.en: The study deliberately separates three questions. First, does the frozen visual representation transfer to hatch matching at all? Second, does motion of the input contribute to the result? Third, is any gain specifically attributable to the biological wiring rather than to the sampling procedure or readout? The first two questions have positive evidence in the present records; the third remains unresolved.
blocks.zh: 研究有意将三个问题分开. 首先,冷冻的视觉表现 转移到孵化匹配吗? 第二,投入的移动是否有助于取得结果? 第三,任何收益是否具体归因于生物线,而不是取样程序或读出? 前两个问题在本记录中有积极的证据;第三个问题仍未解决。

blocks.en: (1) A one-shot hatch-matching protocol in which a frozen fly visual model is used as a 1,368-dimensional descriptor. (2) Controlled synthetic conditions that isolate orientation, pitch, and pattern similarity while clustering uncertainty by source plan. (3) Comparisons against pixel statistics, Gabor and LBP descriptors, several frozen vision encoders, receptors-only features, and small task-trained CNNs. (4) A separation between transfer, motion benefit, and topology claims, including a code-level caveat in the frame-order controls. (5) A small real-drawing audit used only to define the gap to end-to-end deployment.
blocks.zh: (1)一发式舱门比对协议,其中采用冷冻蝇视觉模型作为1,368维的描述符. (2) 控制合成条件,这种条件在按照源计划将不确定性集群的同时,将方向、投子和模式相似性隔离开来。 (3)与像素统计的比较,Gabor和LBP的描述符,几个冷冻的视觉编码器,只受体功能,以及小型任务训练的CNN. (4) 转移、运动利益和地形索赔之间的分离,包括在帧令控制中设置一个代码级的提醒。 (5)一个小型的实时审计只用于确定端到端部署的差距.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Connectome-constrained visual models and active sampling
blocks.zh: 2.1 连接体受限视觉模型和主动取样

blocks.en: Connectome-constrained networks use anatomical connectivity to restrict the structure of a trainable model. Lappalainen et al. [ 1 ] showed that such a network can predict activity across the fly visual system and made the resulting framework available through flyvis [ 2 ] . Biological work on microsaccadic sampling provides a broader motivation for converting fine spatial structure into time-varying input [ 3 ] . The engineering procedure here is much simpler: trajectories are prescribed by the experimenter and the raster itself is translated. It should therefore be viewed as active sampling in the classical computational sense [ 11 ] , not as a model of fly attention or behavior.
blocks.zh: Connectome-control network使用解剖连接来限制可列车模型的结构. Lappalainen 等人著. [1] 表明这种网络能够预测整个飞行视觉系统的活动,并通过Flyvis[2]提供由此形成的框架. 微生物取样方面的生物工作为将精细的空间结构转化为时间变化输入提供了更广泛的动力[3]. 这里的工程程序简单得多:轨迹由实验者规定,光栅本身翻译. 因此,它应该被视为古典计算意义上的活性采样[11],而不是飞行注意力或行为的模型.

blocks.en: Recent whole-brain connectomic graph models target locomotion and body control [ 15 ] . Those results are relevant as evidence that connectome structure can support executable models, but they do not validate a texture classifier. The present experiment uses the visual system model only.
blocks.zh: 近期全脑连接显像图模型瞄准运动和身体控制[15]. 这些结果作为连接体结构可以支持可执行模型的证据是相关的,但它们不能验证纹理分类器. 本实验只使用视觉系统模型.

blocks.en: 2.2 Texture descriptors and pretrained vision encoders
blocks.zh: 2.2 纹理描述器和预先训练的视觉编码器

blocks.en: Gabor filters remain a strong hand-designed reference for oriented frequency structure [ 5 ] , while local binary patterns provide a compact local texture descriptor with explicit invariance choices [ 6 ] . We therefore include both as non-neural baselines. We also compare fixed representations from DINOv2 [ 7 ] , Perception Encoder [ 8 ] , SigLIP 2 [ 9 ] , and DINOv3 [ 10 ] . These are not claimed to be exhaustively tuned for the task; they are frozen feature-extraction recipes evaluated under the same local legend-matching setup.
blocks.zh: Gabor滤波器仍然是面向频率结构的强力手工设计的参考[5],而局部二进制图案则提供了一个紧凑的局部纹理描述器,有明显的偏差选择[6]. 因此,我们把两者都列为非神经基线。 我们还比较了DINOv2 [7]、Perception Encoder [8]、SigLIP 2 [9] 和DINov3 [10] 的固定表述。 这些并非详尽无遗地用于这项任务;它们是在同一个本地传说比对设置下评估的冷冻地物-提取食谱。

blocks.en: 2.3 Floor-plan understanding
blocks.zh: 2.3 基本计划谅解

blocks.en: CubiCasa5K supplies floor-plan geometry and has been widely used for semantic floor-plan analysis [ 4 ] . The benchmark in this paper uses that geometry only as a source of wall regions; hatch patterns, legend rendering, and the controlled appearance conditions are procedural. The task therefore differs from wall detection, room parsing, vectorization, or scan-to-BIM: masks and local legend examples are already supplied to the classifier.
blocks.zh: CubiCasa5K提供地板平面几何,并被广泛用于语义平面平面分析[4]. 本文中的基准仅将几何学作为墙壁区域的来源;孵化图案,传奇渲染,受控的外观条件都是程序性的. 因此任务不同于墙壁检测,房间剖析,矢量化,或扫描到BIM: 口罩和本地传说实例已经提供给分类器.

blocks.en: 3 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3 问题表述

blocks.en: For each sheet, the input consists of (i) a set of masked wall regions, (ii) a legend strip for each local material class, and (iii) the raster drawing. A class is local to the sheet: the method need not know that a particular hatch denotes brick, concrete, or insulation globally. It only has to match query texture to the corresponding legend texture.
blocks.zh: 对于每张工作表,输入内容包括(一)一组蒙面墙区域,(二)每个当地材料类的传说条,(三)光栅图画. 一个等级是局部到表层的:方法不需要知道某一特定舱门表示全球的砖、混凝土或绝缘。 它只需要将查询纹理与相应的传说纹理匹配.

blocks.en: In the primary protocol, four 64 × 64 64\times 64 windows are sampled from each legend strip and three query windows from each selected wall region. Up to forty wall regions are considered per sheet. The geometry and area of each region are provided by the generator rather than inferred by the recognition model. The per-sheet score is an area-weighted classification accuracy, A s = ∑ j a s ​ j 1 [ y ^ s ​ j = y s ​ j ] ∑ j a s ​ j , A = 1 N ​ ∑ s A s . A_{s}=\frac{\sum_{j}a_{sj}\,\mathbf{1}[\hat{y}_{sj}=y_{sj}]}{\sum_{j}a_{sj}},\qquad A=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{s}A_{s}. (1) This quantity is neither pixel IoU nor average precision. It evaluates only the selected regions and averages sheet scores equally after area weighting within each sheet.

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Converting spatial texture into temporal input
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 将空间纹理转换为时间输入

blocks.en: A periodic hatch can be written schematically as I ⁡ ( x ) = a + b ​ cos ⁡ ( 2 ​ π ​ k ⋅ x + ϕ ) . I(x)=a+b\cos(2\pi k\cdot x+\phi). (2) Under a translation x ↦ x + v ​ t x\mapsto x+vt , the temporal rate depends on | k ⋅ v | |k\cdot v| . Moving across the stripes therefore produces a different temporal signal from moving along them, and changing pitch changes the signal again. This identity motivates the stimulus; it is not a biological measurement.

Each 64 × 64 64\times 64 grayscale window is resized to the model eye frame and translated along four directions ( 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} , 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} , 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} , 135 ∘ 135^{\circ} ) at two speeds, giving eight trajectories. Each trajectory contains twelve frames; the first four are treated as settling frames and excluded from the final summary. The simulation step is 20 ms.
4.2 Frozen fly descriptor
blocks.zh: 4.2 冻蝇描述符

blocks.en: The main configuration uses the project checkpoint labeled 001. The fly model is not updated on hatch labels. For each of 57 non-input cell types, three summary statistics are collected from the analyzed frames: mean activity, temporal standard deviation averaged across columns, and spatial variation of time-averaged activity. Concatenating 57 cell types × \times 3 statistics × \times 8 trajectories yields a 1,368-dimensional descriptor.
blocks.zh: 主配置采用标注为001的项目检查站. 苍蝇模型在舱门标签上没有更新. 对于57个非输入单元格类型,从分析框架中收集了3个汇总统计数据:平均活动、各列平均时间标准差和时间平均活动的空间变化。 拼接57个单元格类型 ×\时 3 统计 ×\时 8 轨迹 得出1,368维描述符.

blocks.en: A moving mask retains eye columns whose centers remain inside the wall region over the analyzed forward trajectory. This controls direct contamination from neighboring pixels but does not guarantee that all background influence is absent through receptive fields or recurrent interactions.
blocks.zh: 移动的面具保留着眼柱,其中心留在墙壁区域中,覆盖分析过的前进轨迹。 这控制了来自邻近像素的直接污染,但并不能保证通过接受场或经常性的相互作用来消除所有背景影响.

blocks.en: 4.3 Matching against the legend
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 与传说匹配

blocks.en: The same feature pipeline is applied to legend and query windows. Descriptor coordinates are standardized once per sheet using the legend and query windows together; this is a transductive normalization because unlabeled query statistics influence the scale. Windows are averaged at the object and legend-class level, L2-normalized, and compared by cosine similarity. The predicted class is the nearest legend representation.
blocks.zh: 同样的特性管道适用于传说和查询窗口. 描述符坐标在每张工作表一次使用图例和查询窗口一起进行标准化;由于无标签查询统计影响尺度,这是一个转录正常化. Windows的平均值为对象和传说类,L2-正态化,并以余弦相似度进行比较. 预言类是最近的传说代表.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Study overview. The task receives a supplied wall mask and local legend. The study separates representation transfer, the contribution of imposed motion, and the still-unresolved contribution of biological wiring.
blocks.zh: 图1:研究概况。 任务收到一个供给的墙面面具和当地传说. 该研究分离了代表转移,强制动议的贡献,以及生物线条仍然未解的贡献.

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en: 5.1 Synthetic benchmark
blocks.zh: 5.1 合成基准

blocks.en: The smell_v3 generator combines CubiCasa5K-derived wall geometry with procedural hatches. TRAIN, DEV, and TEST each contain 400 sheets. The present paper reports the 400-sheet DEV set, not a final held-out TEST result. DEV contains 257 source-plan clusters because one source plan can generate more than one rendered sheet.
blocks.zh: 气味_v3生成器结合了CubiCasa5K衍生的墙壁几何与程序舱门. TRAIN、DEV和TEST各载有400张。 本文件报告的是400张表格的DEV集,而不是最后搁置的TEST结果。 DEV包含257个源计划集群,因为一个源计划可以产生一个以上的渲染表.

blocks.en: Four conditions contain 100 sheets each. eqang varies orientation while attempting to keep simple intensity statistics uninformative. eqpitch varies pitch with proportional stroke-width changes. hard and easy vary the visual similarity among material patterns. Material identity is randomized independently of region location, wall thickness, and area.
blocks.zh: 四个条件各包含100张. eqang在试图保持简单的强度统计不具有信息化性的同时,会改变方向. eqpitch随着比例的中风宽度变化而改变投球. 硬而容易地在物质图案中改变视觉相似性. 材料特性是独立于区域位置、壁厚和面积的随机化的。

blocks.en: 5.2 Baselines
blocks.zh: 5.2 基线

blocks.en: Hand-designed baselines include seven brightness statistics, four gradient statistics, their eleven-feature combination, a Gabor bank with six orientations and three wavelengths, and uniform LBP. Frozen deep representations include DINOv2-B/S, PE-core B, SigLIP 2 B, and DINOv3-S under the project’s prescribed pooling recipes. A receptors-only control summarizes the moving photoreceptor input without the downstream connectome. Finally, three small CNNs are trained directly on the synthetic hatch task; the smallest has 5,888 parameters.
blocks.zh: 手工设计的基线包括7个亮度统计、4个梯度统计、11个地貌组合、6个方向和3个波长的Gabor银行以及统一的LBP。 冻结的深度说明包括项目规定的集合食谱下的DINOv2-B/S、PE-core B、SigLIP 2 B和DINOv3-S。 一种仅受体的控制可以总结无下游连接物的移动光受体输入. 最后,三个小型CNN直接接受合成舱门任务的培训;最小的有5,888个参数.

blocks.en: 5.3 Uncertainty and evidence status
blocks.zh: 5.3 不确定性和证据状况

blocks.en: Paired differences are reported with 95% bootstrap intervals based on 5,000 resamples of source-plan clusters, keeping all rendered sheets from a sampled plan together. The intervals are development-set estimates and are not corrected for multiple comparisons.
blocks.zh: 根据5 000个源计划组群的复标,报告95%的靴子间隔差值,将所有制成的单子放在抽样计划中。 间隔是开发设定的估计数,在进行多重比较时不予更正。

blocks.en: Not every number in this manuscript was regenerated from raw model features. The fly scores and bootstrap intervals are taken from the supplied project records because the light research bundle does not contain the latest full feature caches, complete dataset arrays, or model weights. In contrast, all sixteen tests of the metric toolkit passed during manuscript preparation; the nine task-trained CNN seed means were recomputed from saved per-sheet values, and the small real-drawing audit totals were recounted. These evidence levels are kept separate throughout the paper.
blocks.zh: 并非本手稿中的每一个数字都是从原始模型特征中重新生成的. 飞行分数和靴子间隔取自所提供的项目记录,因为光研究捆绑没有包含最新的完整特性缓存,完整的数据集阵列,或模型权重. 与此相反,在手稿编写过程中通过的所有16项计量工具包测试;9项任务训练有素的CNN种子手段从每张表格节省的数值中重新计算出来,并重新计提了少量实际审计总数。 在整个文件中,这些证据水平是分开的。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Active sampling and frozen fly descriptor. Four directions and two speeds yield eight trajectories; three statistics for 57 non-input cell types give a 1,368-dimensional descriptor.
blocks.zh: 图2:活性取样和冷冻蝇描述符。 4个方向和2个速度产生8个轨迹;57个非输入细胞类型的3个统计给出了1,368维的描述符.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Four controlled benchmark conditions, 100 DEV sheets each. Swatches are explanatory schematics, not extra test examples.
blocks.zh: 图3:四个可控基准条件,每份100个DEV页. Swatches是解释性图表,而不是额外的测试实例.

blocks.en: Table 1: Selected raw-legend DEV results. The task-trained CNN is the recomputed three-seed mean; other rows are from project records.
blocks.zh: 表1: 部分原始立法DEV结果。 任务训练的CNN是重算的三种子平均值;其他行来自项目记录.

blocks.en: 6 Results
blocks.zh: 6 结果

blocks.en: 6.1 Main benchmark
blocks.zh: 6.1 主要基准

blocks.en: Under the raw-legend protocol, the frozen fly pipeline reaches 0.857 across the 400 DEV sheets. With the project’s fixed white-background pooling recipe, DINOv2-B reaches 0.757 and DINOv2-S 0.785. The paired fly-minus-DINOv2-B difference is +0.100 [0.077, 0.123], and fly-minus-DINOv2-S is +0.072 [0.051, 0.091]. These comparisons concern specific frozen descriptors, not the best possible adaptation of the underlying model families.
blocks.zh: 根据生腿协议,冷冻的飞管在400个DEV板上达到0.857. 随着该项目的固定白底集合食谱,DINov2-B达到0.757和DINov2-S 0.785. 成对的蝇-负-DINOv2-B差为+0.100 [0.077,0.123],而蝇-负-DINOv2-S差为+0.072 [0.051,0.091]. 这些比较涉及具体的冻结描述,而不是基本模式家庭的最佳适应。

blocks.en: The result varies by condition: 0.840 on orientation, 0.793 on pitch, 0.848 on hard patterns, and 0.945 on easy patterns. The controlled conditions are therefore necessary; the overall mean alone hides substantial variation in what different descriptors can exploit.
blocks.zh: 结果因条件而异:方向0.840,投球0.793,硬图案0.848,简单图案0.945. 因此,控制的条件是必要的;仅仅总的平均值就掩盖了不同描述者可以利用的显著差异。

blocks.en: 6.2 Orientation distinguishes structure from darkness
blocks.zh: 6.2 方向区分结构与黑暗

blocks.en: On the 100-sheet eqang subset, the fly score is 0.840 while eleven simple pixel statistics score 0.299, a paired difference of +0.541 [0.490, 0.590]. This is the clearest evidence that the descriptor carries oriented texture information beyond aggregate darkness. It is not, however, the strongest specialized orientation descriptor: pure Gabor features reach 0.900, giving fly-minus-Gabor = -0.060 [-0.097, -0.024].
blocks.zh: 在100张eqang子集上,苍蝇分数为0.840,而11个简单的像素统计得分为0.299,对比为+0.541 [0.490,0.590]. 这是最清楚的证据表明,描述器携带着超出总的黑暗的定向纹理信息. 然而,它并不是最强的专业定向描述符:纯Gabor特性达到0.900,给予fly-minus-Gabor= -0.060 [-0.097, -0.024].

blocks.en: On the pitch condition the relation changes. The fly reaches 0.793 and pure Gabor 0.714, for +0.079 [0.047, 0.112]. Thus no single representation dominates every controlled texture property.
blocks.zh: 在投球条件上,关系会改变. 苍蝇达到0.793,纯加博尔0.714,为+0.079 [0.047,0.112]. 因此,没有一种单一的表述支配着所有受控制的纹理财产。

blocks.en: 6.3 Legend extent and retinal resolution
blocks.zh: 第6.3条 图例范围和视网膜分辨率

blocks.en: Rendering a wider portion of the same legend strip, while leaving the query windows unchanged, raises the fly result from 0.857 to 0.910, a paired gain of +0.053 [0.039, 0.067]. On orientation alone the score rises from 0.840 to 0.975. The effect is not unique to the fly: several other descriptors improve when the reference contains more of the repeating pattern.
blocks.zh: 渲染相同传奇条的较宽部分,同时保留查询窗口不变,将苍蝇结果从0.857升至0.910,双增益+0.053 [0.039,0.067]. 仅在定向方面,得分从0.840上升到0.975。 效果并非是苍蝇独有的:当参考文献中包含更多的重复图案时,其他几种描述语有所改进.

blocks.en: Increasing the modeled eye from 721 to 1,951 columns at the same paper-space speed raises the raw-legend result to 0.888, +0.031 [0.022, 0.041]. This experiment demonstrates a resolution effect, not a claim about computational efficiency or biological acuity.
blocks.zh: 将模型化的眼从721列提升到1,951列,以相同的纸张空间速度将原列结果提升到0.888,+0.031[0.022,0.041]. 这一试验显示的是分辨率效应,而不是关于计算效率或生物敏锐度的要求。

blocks.en: 6.4 Small task-trained CNNs set a high practical baseline
blocks.zh: 6.4 (中文(简体) ). 小型任务训练有素的有线电视新闻网设定了较高的实际基线

blocks.en: The smallest trained CNN contains 5,888 parameters and averages 0.959 across three saved seeds (0.967, 0.953, 0.958). The 18,672-parameter model also averages 0.959, while the 92,672-parameter model averages 0.966. All nine recorded task-trained runs exceed the frozen fly’s 0.857. The frozen-transfer result is therefore scientifically interesting, but it is not evidence that simulating the fly circuit is the most efficient engineering choice once task-specific training is allowed.
blocks.zh: 训练最小的CNN包含5,888个参数,在三种保存的种子(0.967,0.953,0.958)中平均为0.959个. 18,672-参数模型也平均为0.959,92,672-参数模型平均为0.966. 所有九次任务训练都超过了冰冻苍蝇的0.857。 因此,冷冻转移结果在科学上是有趣的,但并不是有证据表明,一旦允许特定任务培训,模拟飞行电路是最有效的工程选择.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Selected raw-legend results on 400 DEV sheets. Project-recorded fly and frozen-baseline values are shown alongside the recomputed three-seed mean of the smallest task-trained CNN.
blocks.zh: 图4:400份DEV纸片的原始底稿选取结果。 项目记录的苍蝇和冷冻基线值与经过任务训练的最小CNN的重算的三种子平均值一并显示。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Orientation-controlled subset. The fly representation is much stronger than simple pixel statistics, while a specialized Gabor descriptor is stronger still.
blocks.zh: 图5:定向控制子集。 苍蝇代表比简单的像素统计要强得多,而专业的Gabor描述符仍然更强壮.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Extending the reference legend improves several representations without changing the query windows.
blocks.zh: 图6:扩展参考传说在不改变查询窗口的情况下改进了几种表达方式.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Three task-trained CNN seeds per model size. All nine recorded runs exceed the frozen fly score under the raw-legend protocol.
blocks.zh: 图7:每个型号大小有三个任务训练的CNN种子. 所有9个记录的运行都超过了根据原始立方协议冻结的苍蝇得分.

blocks.en: 7 Motion and Wiring Controls
blocks.zh: 7 运动和电线控制

blocks.en: 7.1 Motion is useful under the current readout
blocks.zh: 7.1 当前读出下的动议有用

blocks.en: On the 200 sheets from the two equalized conditions, repeating the central frame gives 0.727. Forward drift improves the score by 0.089 [0.066, 0.112]. Because the frozen circuit and summary rule are held fixed, this establishes that the imposed input motion is associated with a meaningful performance gain under the current pipeline. The comparison does not isolate a particular biological mechanism: spatial resampling and the temporal response it produces change together.
blocks.zh: 在两个平等条件的200张纸上,重复中央框架给出0.727. 前进漂移使比分提高0.089 [0.066,0.112]. 由于被冻结的电路和即时规则是固定的,这证明强制的输入运动与当前管道下有意义的性能收益有关. 比较并不孤立一个特定的生物机制:空间再生及其同时产生变化的时间反应.

blocks.en: 7.2 The topology contribution is not yet isolated
blocks.zh: 第7.2条 地貌学贡献尚未孤立

blocks.en: A descriptor built directly from the moving receptor signals, without the downstream connectome, reaches 0.891 on all 400 sheets, compared with 0.857 for the fly network. The paired fly-minus-receptors difference is -0.035 [-0.049, -0.021]. This makes active sampling itself the most obvious reusable engineering idea.
blocks.zh: 由移动受体信号直接建造的描述器,没有下游连接体,在所有400张纸上达到0.891,而蝇网则达到0.857. 配对的蝇-负受体差为-0.035[-0.049,-0.021]. 这使得主动采样本身成为最明显的可重复使用的工程理念.

blocks.en: The receptors-only experiment is not a matched ablation of biological wiring. It uses four statistics per trajectory, including a mean absolute inter-frame difference, whereas the network uses three statistics per cell type; the descriptor dimensionalities and readouts differ. A decisive topology test should equalize the input, readout capacity, dimensionality, tuning budget, and seeds, then compare the biological graph with degree-preserving shuffled and random graphs.
blocks.zh: 仅受体的实验并不是生物线的匹配衰减. 它使用每个轨迹的4个统计数据,包括平均绝对的间距差,而网络使用每个单元格类型的3个统计数据;描述维度和读出值不同. 决定性的地形测试应该将输入、读取能力、维度、调整预算和种子等同,然后将生物图与保留学位的洗动图和随机图进行比较。

blocks.en: 7.3 Frame-order controls require correction
blocks.zh: 7.3 框架命令控制需要更正

blocks.en: The saved differences for shuffled and reversed frame orders are small. Source inspection found that the moving mask is computed from the forward trajectory after settling while the image frames are reordered separately. The mask is therefore not recomputed for the analyzed tail of the shuffled or reversed sequences. Those order-control values should be treated as descriptive until the mask is made order-consistent. This issue does not invalidate the separate forward-drift versus repeated-frame comparison.
blocks.zh: 用于洗牌和倒置帧命令的保存差异很小. 源码检查发现,移动遮罩是在安顿后从前方轨迹中计算出来的,而图像框则单独重新排列. 因此,面具对于被洗涤或倒置的序列分析的尾巴并不重算. 这些命令控制值应作为描述性处理,直到使面具符合命令为止。 这个问题并不使单独进行的前向驱动和重复式帧比较无效。

blocks.en: 8 Real-World Audit and Scope
blocks.zh: 8 真实世界审计和范围

blocks.en: The synthetic task starts with a correct wall mask and a usable local legend. A real drawing-recognition system must additionally find the wall, preserve scale, distinguish hatch from text and dimensions, extract the legend, handle classes missing from the legend, and abstain when evidence is insufficient.
blocks.zh: 合成任务从正确的壁罩和可用的本地传说开始. 一个真正的图画识别系统必须额外找到墙壁,保存尺度,区分密舱与文字和维度,提取传说,处理传说中缺失的类,并在证据不足时弃权.

blocks.en: A small selected audit of saved product outputs was reviewed separately. Forty cases were inspected by the project owner; nine were marked “cannot determine” and six “not a wall.” Among the remaining twenty-five class-checkable cases, eleven saved product labels matched the owner’s answer. This 11/25 count is not an estimate of the fly model’s real-world accuracy: the saved label belongs to the combined product, the sample is small and selected, and the reviewer is the project owner.
blocks.zh: 对节省的产品产出进行的小规模选定审计分别进行了审查。 项目负责人检查了40个案例;9个标有“无法确定”和6个“不是墙”。 在其余25个可分类检验的案例中,有11个已保存的产品标签与业主的答复相符。 这个11/25的计数并不是对苍蝇模型真实世界准确性的估计:保存的标签属于综合产品,样本是小的和被选中的,审查者是项目所有人.

blocks.en: The audit is therefore used only as a boundary marker. End-to-end claims require an independently annotated real-project benchmark with predefined inclusion rules, explicit unknown-class handling, project-level train/development/test separation, and separate error accounting for geometry, legend extraction, texture matching, and abstention.
blocks.zh: 因此,审计仅用作界标。 端对端索赔要求独立附加说明的真项目基准,有预先界定的包含规则,明确的未知级处理,项目级列车/开发/测试分离,以及分别计算几何,传奇提取,纹理匹配和弃权等错误.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Selected paired differences with source-plan bootstrap intervals. Positive values favor the first term in each comparison.
blocks.zh: 图 8: 选定的配对差异与源计划靴子间隔。 正值有利于每个比较中的第一个术语.

blocks.en: 9 Discussion
blocks.zh: 9 讨论情况

blocks.en: 9.1 What transfers
blocks.zh: 9.1 国家 哪些转让

blocks.en: The central positive result is transfer. A visual model constrained by fly connectivity and optimized for a motion-related domain can be frozen, driven by controlled raster motion, and used as a useful descriptor for a document texture task. The orientation result shows that this descriptor is not merely reading mean darkness. The forward-motion control shows that moving the input contributes under the current readout.
blocks.zh: 核心的积极成果是转让。 一个受飞行连通性制约的视觉模型,对运动相关领域进行优化,可以被冻结,受控制光栅运动驱动,并作为文档纹理任务的有用描述符. 定向结果显示,这种描述法不仅仅是读取暗语。 前进运动控制显示,移动输入在当前读出下会有所贡献.

blocks.en: The most reusable idea may be simpler than the biological model itself: turn spatial texture into a temporal signal by scanning it. The strong receptors-only result is consistent with that interpretation. Whether the downstream biological topology adds value under a fair matched readout remains the main mechanistic question.
blocks.zh: 最可重复使用的想法可能比生物模型本身简单:通过扫描将空间纹理转化为时间信号. 只有强受体的结果符合这种解释。 下游生物地形在公平对应的读取下是否增加价值仍然是主要的机械问题。

blocks.en: 9.2 Anatomical tools are context, not evidence for the classifier
blocks.zh: 9.2 解剖工具是上下文,不是分类器的证据

blocks.en: Virtual Fly Brain provides anatomical records and connectomic context [ 12 ] . vfb-connect provides programmatic access to those data [ 13 ] , while geppetto-vfb implements parts of the web visualization stack [ 14 ] . These tools are useful for formulating cell-type-specific intervention hypotheses. They are not model weights, and no VFB query or morphology feature is used in the reported hatch classifier.
blocks.zh: Virtual Fly Brain提供解剖记录和连接上下文[12]. vfb-connect提供程序访问这些数据[13],而gepetto-vfb则执行部分网络可视化堆栈[14]. 这些工具对于形成细胞类型的特定干预假设是有用的. 它们不是模型权重,在报告的舱门分类器中没有使用VFB查询或形态特征.

blocks.en: 9.3 Decisive next experiment
blocks.zh: 9.3 下一次决定性试验

blocks.en: Before opening the held-out TEST set, the dataset version, weights, trajectories, mask implementation, normalization, and readout should be frozen. The corrected evaluation should compare: (i) the biological fly network, (ii) receptors-only features, (iii) degree-preserving shuffled networks, (iv) random-graph controls, (v) Gabor, and (vi) a small task-trained CNN under explicit tuning budgets. Only then can the topology question be answered. A separate project-level real-drawing benchmark should evaluate the full recognition pipeline.
blocks.zh: 在打开被搁置的TEST集之前,数据集版本,权重,轨迹,面具执行,正常化,以及读出应被冻结. 校正的评价应当比较: (一)生物蝇网络, (二)仅受体特征, (三)保温洗网, (四)随机图控, (五)Gabor, (六)明确调整预算下的小型任务训练CNN. 只有这样,才能回答地形问题。 单独的项目级实测基准应评价全部确认管道。

blocks.en: 10 Limitations
blocks.zh: 10 限制

blocks.en: First, the headline results are from a repeatedly used DEV set rather than an untouched final TEST split. Second, the moving mask does not guarantee removal of all surrounding context through the model’s receptive fields. Third, the receptors-only and network readouts are not capacity-matched, so they do not isolate topology. Fourth, the frame-order ablations contain a mask-order mismatch and should be rerun. Fifth, the deep frozen baselines are specific feature-extraction recipes rather than exhaustive adaptations. Sixth, the real-drawing audit is small, selected, and owner-reviewed. Finally, no latency, memory, energy, or deployment-cost comparison was performed.
blocks.zh: 首先,头条结果来自反复使用的DEV集,而不是未触动的最终TEST分裂. 其次,移动的面具并不能保证通过模型的可接受字段去除所有周围环境. 第三,只有受体和网络读取能力不匹配,所以不会孤立地形. 第四,帧-顺序擦擦包含一个面具-顺序错配,应当重新运行. 第五,深冻的基线是具体的特征提取方法,而不是详尽无遗的修改。 第六,实画审计规模小,有选择的,由所有者审核. 最后,没有进行长期性、记忆、能量或部署费用比较。

blocks.en: 11 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 11 结论

blocks.en: Active visual sampling makes a connectome-constrained fly visual model useful outside its original motion setting. On a controlled synthetic hatch-matching benchmark, the frozen pipeline reaches 0.857 area-weighted accuracy, improves to 0.910 with a wider legend, and substantially exceeds simple pixel statistics on an orientation-controlled subset. Motion itself contributes a measurable gain. At the same time, receptors-only features and small task-trained CNNs prevent a stronger conclusion: the current data do not establish that the biological wiring is the source of the advantage or that the fly model is the best practical classifier.
blocks.zh: 主动的视觉采样使得一个连接体受约束的飞行视觉模型在其最初的运动设定之外有用. 在受控的合成舱门比对基准上,冷冻管道达到0.857区加权精度,随着较广的传说改进到0.910,并大大超过定向控制子集的简单像素统计. 动议本身可以带来可衡量的收益。 同时,仅受体的特性和小型任务训练的CNN阻止了更强的结论:当前数据没有确定生物线条是优势的来源或者飞行模型是最佳的实用分类器.

blocks.en: The result is therefore a demonstration of transferable visual computation, not a claim of general drawing understanding. That narrower statement is both supported by the present evidence and testable by the next set of matched controls.
blocks.zh: 因此,结果证明是可转移的视觉计算,而不是对一般绘图理解的要求。 这一范围较窄的说法既得到现有证据的支持,又得到下一套相应控制措施的检验。

blocks.en: Data and Code Availability
blocks.zh: 数据和代码可用性

blocks.en: The article was prepared from the supplied research bundles dated 19 September 2026. The distributable package accompanying this draft contains the manuscript, figures, benchmark tables, recomputed CNN summaries, and verification notes. The latest end-to-end fly simulation cannot be reproduced from the light bundle alone because the current feature caches, complete dataset arrays, and model weights are not included.
blocks.zh: 这篇文章是根据2026年9月19日提供的研究包编写的。 本草案所附的可分发包包括手稿、数字、基准表、重编的CNN摘要和核查说明。 由于当前特性缓存,完整的数据集阵列,模型权重不包含,因此无法单独从光束中复制最新的端对端飞行模拟.

blocks.zh: 在编写这篇文章时使用了基因AI。
